company.name: CTERA Networks
company.shortDescription: CTERA enables enterprises to securely sync, share, protect and govern files from any device or office, all from the cloud of their choice.
company.description: CTERA enables enterprise IT to provide secure file services from any cloud. Trusted by the Fortune 100 and leading service providers, the CTERA Enterprise File Services Platform is a private cloud IT-as-a-Service platform for storing, syncing, sharing, protecting and governing data across endpoints, remote offices and servers.

productsAndServices.description: An edge-to-cloud file services platform for centrally managed file storage, synchronization, sharing, backup, governance, and collaboration across distributed offices and users.
productsAndServices.name: CTERA Enterprise File Services Platform

productsAndServices.description: A centralized cloud management and file-services application for administering users, teams, endpoints, Edge Filers, policies, storage, and data access.
productsAndServices.name: CTERA Portal

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-connected file server and storage gateway that provides local file access, caching, backup, synchronization, cloud tiering, and disaster recovery for offices and remote locations.
productsAndServices.name: CTERA Edge Filer

productsAndServices.description: Desktop and mobile software for secure file access, synchronization, sharing, collaboration, and endpoint backup from laptops, tablets, and smartphones.
productsAndServices.name: CTERA Drive

productsAndServices.description: A distributed file system that provides a single namespace for files across offices, endpoints, private clouds, public clouds, and object-storage platforms.
productsAndServices.name: CTERA Global File System

productsAndServices.description: A machine-learning-based ransomware protection capability that detects and blocks suspicious file activity and provides an administrative incident-management dashboard.
productsAndServices.name: CTERA Ransom Protect

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Private Equity round raised $80,000,000, or 44.44% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $24,624,461 to $649,270,603, a 26.37x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 56 (-8 over 90 days) and market heat at 16 (-35).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
